title: Jeff Bezos is reportedly about to buy a third of Liverpool FC.
summary: Sky Sports reports that the Amazon founder is part of an investment consortium, along with Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin, close to buying a roughly 30-percent stake in one of the Premier League’s most successful clubs.
